source_kind: NBA-derived SportsDataverse archives reconciled to exact current-main ESPN-derived rows
baseline_kind: frozen last10 FP and historical observed participation; not exact deployed app runtime
limitations: Only two NBA dates have completed; no date-cluster confidence interval or robust promotion proof
Game bootstrap is descriptive with only five or eight games per cohort
Source archives can incorporate later stat corrections; no atomic source vintage guarantee
FP targets reconstruct the NBA formula and are not independent official Sports.ru credited points
UNKNOWN and conflicting FP remain excluded with explicit denominators; agreed participation survives FP-only conflicts
No owner transactions, prices, quota or economic gain tested
Week/player multi-game predictive intervals are not validated by these one-game-per-player cohorts
